exposure: gd T cell frequencies (total, Vd1+, Vd2+ subsets)
outcome: Vd1+ gd T cell subset levels
Vd2+ gd T cell subset levels
cohort: The cohort consisted of HIV-positive (n=47) and HIV-negative (n=45) pregnant women enrolled in early pregnancy at Chris Hani Baragwanath Academic Hospital in Soweto, South Africa.
finding: Maternal HIV infection was associated with altered gd T cell frequencies (reduced Vd2+, increased Vd1+, and reversed Vd1/Vd2 ratio), and lower total gd T cell levels and reduced CCR6+ Vd1 T cells in early pregnancy were associated with preterm birth, particularly in HIV-positive women.
gest_age: Determined by first trimester ultrasound scan
